## Load in Data & Libraries
```{r}
# Neuralnet and Caret libraries loaded
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)

# Loading in Training and testing data from RDS
train_data <- readRDS("rds/song_train.rds")
test_data <- readRDS("rds/song_test.rds")

# Initial visualizations of the data
str(train_data)
summary(train_data)
```

## Build Baseline ANN
```{r, cache=TRUE}
ann_model <- neuralnet(hit ~ .,
                       data = train_data,
                       hidden = 1,
                       linear.output = FALSE,
                       threshold = 0.05,
                       rep = 5,
                       stepmax = 1e8,
                       lifesign = "full")

# Find the integer index of the lowest-error repetition
best_rep <- which.min(ann_model$result.matrix["error", ])

p <- predict(ann_model, test_data, rep = best_rep)
confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(p[, ncol(p)] > 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1)), factor(test_data$hit, levels = c(0, 1)), positive = "1")
```
The above confusion matrix is roughly 90% accurate, which is a solid starting point.
